interface.name: wl_drm
interface.description: This interface hands Wayland clients the DRM device node they must allocate on, plus the buffer formats the compositor accepts. Actual buffer sharing goes through zwp_linux_dmabuf; the legacy GEM-flink requests below are parsed but refused.

request.name: authenticate
request.description: Render-node clients skip this; we always answer authenticated.

request.name: create_buffer
request.description: Always refused with invalid_format; clients must use linux-dmabuf.

event.name: device

description.summary: DRM device node the client must open

event.description: A render node needs no authentication; regular card nodes would.

description.summary: a buffer format the compositor accepts
client is authenticated for DRM access

event.name: invalid_format

description.summary: refusal of the last create_* buffer

event.description: Sent when a create_buffer, create_planar_buffer or create_prime_buffer request cannot produce a usable buffer. The client correlates it with the buffer it just created and is expected to fall back to another allocation path.
